items.title: 2026 APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting Powered Entirely by Green Electricity

items.summary: As China prepares to host APEC 2026 in Shenzhen, an article argues that regional cooperation benefits economies well beyond the Asia-Pacific. Using Xi Jinping's 2014 'geese flying together' metaphor for the 21-member bloc, it stresses shared prosperity as a foundation for trade. In 2024, these economies accounted for 61% of global GDP and 46% of world goods and services trade. China's growth—GDP doubling from roughly $9.59 trillion in 2014 to about $14 trillion by 2025—and rising imports have boosted Southeast Asian exporters through streamlined e-commerce certificate exchanges with Malaysia, while the Port of Chancay has cut shipping times for Peruvian and Ecuadorian produce to Shanghai. The piece contends that larger economies open markets and finance infrastructure, enabling smaller partners to win customers and sustain trade.
items.title: How Asia-Pacific Cooperation Is Shaping the Global Economy

items.summary: As the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting prepares in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, digital infrastructure has become central to inclusive Asia-Pacific cooperation. Experts discuss easing computing-power and energy bottlenecks, responsible tech investment, and pragmatic guidance for participants: economies need not build foundation models from scratch but can adapt mature AI solutions to local industrial and agricultural needs.
items.title: Digital Silk Road: Bytes and a Shared Future for APEC

items.summary: Databricks has made Genie Migrate for Lakehouse generally available. It is an AI coding agent that automates end-to-end migration of SQL from legacy data warehouses to the Databricks Lakehouse as open ANSI SQL, mapping dependencies and converting files in parallel while letting engineers review results. All seven supported sources—Microsoft SQL Server, Azure Synapse, Teradata, Oracle, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery—are now generally available; ETL support is coming soon. On benchmarks the agent converted more than 90% of files correctly for each source. MIXI's MONSTER STRIKE team reported that about 85% of tested BigQuery files ran without manual edits, with the rest needing only one-line fixes.
items.title: Databricks Genie Migrate for Lakehouse Reaches General Availability Across Seven Data Warehouses

items.summary: Nearly three years after the October 2023 glacial lake outburst flood on the Teesta river breached South Lhonak Lake and displaced roughly 80,000 people, families remain stranded in makeshift relief camps across Kalimpong, West Bengal. While Sikkim declared a disaster and sanctioned 4,100 houses plus ₹67.05 lakhs in rental aid to 447 people, West Bengal never classified the flood as such, leaving survivors without housing or support and fearing eviction from forest land. Repeated damage surveys have yet to yield relief: only 116 planned homes await state finance sanction. The riverbed reportedly rose six to 14 metres, with consecutive floods in 2024 and 2025 worsening vulnerability. Experts warn that flood mitigation must occur during the dry season—a window lost through delayed action—while political friction between the GTA and BJP has further stalled governance.
items.title: Three Years After Teesta's GLOF, Survivors Remain in Limbo as the River Closes In

items.summary: A World Weather Attribution rapid analysis found human-caused climate change amplified extreme heat during Indonesia's 2026 fire season, turning an El Niño-driven drought into a severe regional crisis. Fires burned about 1.9 million hectares of peatland and rainforest in western Indonesia between August and October 2026.
items.title: Climate Change Intensified Indonesia's 2026 Fire Crisis

items.summary: An alleged illegal surveillance operation targeting President Prabowo Subianto and other senior figures has exposed deep tensions in Indonesia's security establishment. Former police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo was among four officers named as suspects; investigators say communications were intercepted without authorization across 2025-2026 before records were deleted. The new police chief, Suyudi Ario Seto, confirmed the operation targeted a broad range of officials and activists. Amnesty International called for investigations into whether critics were intimidated. Analysts trace widespread surveillance to Suharto-era practices that persist today, with no effective regulation constraining law enforcement. The scandal intensifies friction between Prabowo and predecessor Joko Widodo amid ongoing leadership turmoil.
items.title: Indonesia's Wiretapping Scandal Opens a Political Fault Line
